name: Password Recovery Request Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for requesting password recovery while delegating password reset mechanics to the existing password manager.
notes: The handler records the canonical transition outcome but does not implement token generation or email delivery mechanics.
AuthenticationFlowService rejects any transition other than auth.transition.recovery.request for this flow.

sourceReferences.note: Current endpoint still delegates directly to IPasswordManager.SendResetPasswordLinkAsync and remains to be routed through AuthenticationFlowService.
